The combination of a self-resolving monoarthritis (knee), recent camping in an endemic area (Minnesota), and the onset of wrist pain with fever and skin lesions is classic for disseminated Lyme disease. We have sufficient clinical evidence and laboratory data to proceed with this diagnosis.
